title: Will Bitcoin reach $150,000 by June 2025?
description: This market resolves YES if Bitcoin (BTC/USD) trades at or above $150,000 on any major exchange (Coinbase, Binance, Kraken) at any point before June 30, 2025 23:59:59 UTC.
resolution_criteria: Based on CoinMarketCap 24h high price. Must hit $150,000 or above.

title: Will Ethereum reach $5,000 by end of 2025?
description: Resolves YES if Ethereum (ETH/USD) trades at or above $5,000 on any major exchange before December 31, 2025 23:59:59 UTC.

title: Will Kansas City Chiefs win Super Bowl LX?
description: This market resolves YES if the Kansas City Chiefs win Super Bowl LX in February 2026. Resolves NO if any other team wins.
resolution_criteria: Official NFL game result of Super Bowl LX

title: Will Donald Trump be inaugurated as President in January 2025?
description: Resolves YES if Donald Trump is inaugurated as the 47th President of the United States on January 20, 2025.

title: Will OpenAI announce AGI in 2025?
description: Resolves YES if OpenAI officially announces they have achieved Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) at any point in 2025.
resolution_criteria: Official OpenAI blog post or press release explicitly claiming AGI achievement

title: Will SpaceX launch Starship to Mars in 2025?
description: Resolves YES if SpaceX successfully launches a Starship vehicle on a trajectory to Mars at any point in 2025.
resolution_criteria: Official SpaceX confirmation of Mars-bound trajectory

title: Will GTA 6 release in 2025?
description: Resolves YES if Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is officially released and available for purchase on any platform before December 31, 2025 23:59:59 UTC.
resolution_criteria: Official Rockstar Games release, playable by consumers

title: Will SPY close above $500 in 2025?
description: Resolves YES if the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) closes at or above $500.00 on any trading day in 2025.

title: Will Arsenal win the Premier League 2024-25?
description: Resolves YES if Arsenal FC wins the English Premier League title for the 2024-2025 season.

title: Will Solana reach $200 in 2025?
description: Resolves YES if Solana (SOL/USD) trades at or above $200 on any major exchange at any point before December 31, 2025 23:59:59 UTC.
